protocol:
1. Prepare an open-bench workstation with blue nitrile gloves, an open written protocol, micropipettes, disposable tip boxes, microcentrifuge tubes/racks, a pen/marker, wipes, and a small benchtop instrument with a hinged lid/display; no reagent labels or instrument parameters are readable.

2. Review the written protocol at the bench before handling the sample materials.

3. Fit a disposable tip onto a micropipette from the bench tip box.

4. Transfer an unidentified liquid using the micropipette into or between small microcentrifuge tube(s) at the workstation; the pipette setting and delivered volume are not visible.

5. Place the handled sample/tube at the small benchtop instrument and operate the instrument; no speed, time, temperature, or readout value is visible.

6. Record information or label materials using a pen/marker on the bench next to the open protocol.

7. Retrieve a blue-and-white supply box from the bench/shelf area and bring it to the workstation.

8. Remove or select required small lab materials from the supply box, then return the box to the shelf.

9. Place blue racks/containers holding white-capped tubes or bottles on the bench near the workstation.

10. Continue preparing the small tube(s) at the right-hand workstation using the selected materials and micropipette; no reagent identity, volume, incubation time, or temperature is visible.
